decisionsTitle: Who may offer to volunteer: anyone, the club's signed-in members, or only people it invites by email
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-19 08:30**, on the event's volunteers (§754, §768): «On the volunteers form I want extra settings so that I can have "invite only volunteer" "private vs public lists of volunteers" "Brașov Runners only" volunteers.» This decision is the first and the third of the three, as one choice; the public or private list is the next decision's. Amends §754 and §768 (who may offer — the offer's rule) and borrows its shape from §647 (the invitations by email for a registration) and §524 and §552 (the members' sign-in).

**Decision.** The «Voluntari» card of an event gets a radio group **«Cine se poate oferi»**, under «Primește voluntari» and only while it is ticked (`events.volunteers_access`, a closed set of three, default `ANYONE`, migration `0171`):

- **«Oricine, de pe pagina evenimentului»** (`ANYONE`) — what it always was: the event's page carries «Căutăm voluntari: …» and the button, the volunteers' page the form.
- **«Doar membrii clubului (conectați în zona membrilor)»** (`MEMBERS`) — the event's page says «Căutăm voluntari dintre membrii clubului: …» (the same box for every visitor, drawn from the public cache, so the event's page stays static and reads no session). The volunteers' page shows the form only to a signed-in member (`membersViewer`: `MEMBER` or any staff role), with the name and the address filled from the account, the address read-only and «Fac parte din grupul» ticked and locked; a stranger reads «Voluntarii pentru acest eveniment sunt membrii clubului — intră în zona membrilor.» and the sign-in in the members' words (`?to=members&back=volunteers&slug=<slug>`), never the form. **The sign-in comes back to this page**, not to the members' zone: `back` is one page name and `slug` must fit the events' own pattern (`staff-identity/domain/landing.ts#signInBackOf`, a closed return, never a path from the address — the destination is rebuilt by `getPathname`), for the provider's sign-in and the development switcher alike. **The POST asks again on the server** (`submitVolunteer` → `mayVolunteerWith`): a stranger is refused (`FORBIDDEN`, nothing written, the page then says what it is for), a member's address must be the account's, and `club_member` is set from the account whatever was posted. The session is read for this choice alone and, in the action, only when no invitation came with the post.
- **«Doar cu invitație de la club»** (`INVITED`) — the event's page draws no box; the volunteers' page answers **404** without a link and with a link that names no invitation (a made-up secret is no better than none: the page does not confirm that an address is wrong), a bare `?volunteer=1` is a 404 too unless this browser's own sealed thank-you facts came with it, and with `?invite=<secret>` shows the form with the invited address locked.

**The invitations** (`event_volunteer_invitations`, the table beside `event_invitations` of §647 and dropping everything that holds a place): an Administrator or an Organizer (`canManageVolunteers`) writes addresses, one per line, up to 50 at a time, an optional line of the club's — **in both languages or neither** (§354: «Mesaj (română)» and «Message (English)», the house's RO|EN tabs with «Tradu din română»; 500 characters each; one language alone is refused, `VINVITE_MESSAGE_ONE_LANGUAGE`, naming the language still owed; stored in `message_ro` / `message_en`, the table's CHECK holding both-or-neither) — and the email's language, and presses **«Trimite invitațiile»** in the card's new fold **«Invitații»** (shown while the choice is `INVITED`, and as long as any invitation exists). One row and one `VOLUNTEER_INVITATION` email per address (the public audience, the announcements' road — an invitation holds nothing, so a late one loses nobody anything): «Te invităm să fii voluntar la <eveniment>», the club's line (each half of the bilingual email says its own language's words, the second half's carried as `messageOther` the way an organizer's note is), the roles that still need people, the event's facts block, and the button «Mă ofer voluntar». An address with a live invitation is not sent a second one (that is «Retrimite»), one that already offered is not invited, and one whose invitation was withdrawn or ran out comes back on the same row (the table keeps one per address and event). The send, like «Retrimite», is refused while the offer itself is closed (`volunteerOfferClosedFor`: not published, the event over, no role needing people, the notice or the agreement not in force) — nothing is sent that leads to a 404. The list shows each address with where it stands (sent, used, withdrawn, expired — two stamps and the event's own state, no status column), and «Retrimite» (a new email; the earlier link stops working **at the press**, its fingerprint cleared in the same update) and «Retrage» (the link says «Clubul a retras invitația.») on an open row as confirmed actions. Audited as `volunteer_invitation.sent`, `.resent`, `.withdrawn` and `.used` with the invitation's id and never an address, a name or the club's line.

**The link** follows §12.8 and BR-REQ-036-02: the secret exists in the email alone, only its SHA-256 is kept (`token_hash`, unique), it is minted **when the email is rendered** — the outbox's payload names the invitation and the event by id and nothing else — and a newer email's link replaces the older one's in the same statement; a GET (the page's read) writes nothing; the sign-up **spends it in its own transaction** by one conditional UPDATE (not used, not withdrawn, before its date) so of two presses at once only one wins and a refusal after it takes the spend back; every unknown, malformed or other event's link says the one generic «invalid». The address on the form is the invitation's whatever is posted. **An invitation is open while it is neither used nor withdrawn and its event is still ahead** (`invitationStandingOf(invitation, eventAhead)`, the event asked now, `volunteerEventAhead`): `expires_at` is the event's end at the send, kept as a record and never the rule, so a race postponed past it keeps every link and «Retrimite» (the first review's finding — nothing moved the stored deadline when the date changed). A used, withdrawn or run-out link says so in one sentence. A message whose invitation was used, withdrawn or has run out, whose address was corrected or whose event was called off or is over is withdrawn at the send (§331).

**A live invitation is a door in every choice, and a dead one shuts nothing the choice opens anyway.** Under «Oricine» and for a member under «Doar membrii» a used, withdrawn or run-out link leaves the ordinary form and says which in a sentence above it (the server goes on with the post as if it had come without the link); a link that names nothing says nothing there. Switching the choice later deletes nothing — not a sign-up, not an invitation. `INVITED` → `ANYONE` keeps the sent links working until used; `ANYONE` → `INVITED` closes the public form at the next read (the save tells the public cache); a person the club had already invited is not locked out by narrowing it. The invitation holds nothing and counts nothing: no «needed» seat of a role and no place of a race.

**Carried** by a duplicate, by every date of a repeat and by the event's JSON file (`volunteers.access`, written only when it is not `ANYONE`, so a file of an event that never narrowed it stays readable by the release before this one; applied to an event made new, never over an existing one) — unlike the tick «Primește voluntari», the shirts and the public count (§754, §765, §773), which a copy never inherits: the choice is the club's standing rule for who helps, and every value but the default only narrows the door, so a copy can never open more than its source did. A copy still starts with «Primește voluntari» off.

**Personal data.** An invitation holds an address and the club's line: it is deleted with the event's volunteers (`jobs/retention.ts`, step `volunteers`, thirty days after the event began, counted with the offers), with the volunteer the card deletes (same event, same address), and when the event goes; it is listed on the person's data screen («Toate datele unei persoane») and in its export (`volunteerInvitations`, art. 15 GDPR) — the address, the club's line in both languages, the language and every moment — and **an Administrator erases the invitations sent to one address from that screen** («Șterge invitațiile de voluntariat», asking first, art. 17; `eraseVolunteerInvitationsOfPerson`, audited as `participant.volunteer_invitations_erased` with the count and never an address), since an unused or withdrawn invitation holds an address and the club's line and nothing else. Deleting a volunteer deletes the invitation the sign-up came through by the sign-up's own id as well as by the address, so a colleague's correction of the address leaves none behind. The retention sweep counts the invitations on their own line (`counts.volunteerInvitations`). **The privacy notice's template** (`{{volunteers}}`'s paragraph in section 5) gets one sentence in both languages — the invitation by email (the address, the organizers' line in both languages, when sent, used or withdrawn, the single-use link, **its legal basis — the club's legitimate interest in inviting its volunteers, art. 6(1)(f) — and the source of the address, the person or the club's contacts, art. 14(2)(f)**, deleted with the offer, thirty days after the event) and the member's account filling the form — under the marker that already gates the form (no new switch: a notice approved before keeps the form working and says none of it; the lawyer reads the sentence next sitting). The agreement's text is untouched.

**Where the page is cached.** The volunteers' page was already `force-dynamic` (the bot check's clock, the sealed draft, the answer in the address). Nothing per viewer is stored in a shared cache: the roles, the choice and the texts come from the public cache's one entry (`readVolunteerOffer`, `cachedVolunteerRoles`, expired by every write to them), and the session and the link are met with them after, on this request alone. The event's page stays static because it never reads who is looking.

**Refused.** A second mail per address (that is «Retrimite»); an invitation that holds a seat of a role (an offer is not yet a role given, §761); a per-invitation expiry typed by the club (the event's end); a new privacy marker for the invitation (the brief: the existing gate stays — the owner and the lawyer decide whether a notice approved before may keep sending invitations unread); saving the choice for a whole series (the card's own form writes one event, as the ticks beside it do — the card says so: «Alegerea e doar pentru această dată»; the series carry stays for the dates a repeat makes later); a deadline moved on the stored column by the event's save (the standing asks the event instead). **Not done, and why:** the review's claim that retention never reaches an event with no date — `events.starts_at` is never null (a date to be announced keeps whatever the organizer typed), so the sweep's clock reaches every event, and the invitations are swept thirty days after it with the offers. **Not decided here:** the public or private list of volunteers (the next decision's). **For the lawyer's next sitting:** the notice's invitation sentence with its basis and source.
changelogLine: - **Who may offer to volunteer** — the «Voluntari» card of an event has a new choice, **«Cine se poate oferi»**: anyone (as before), only the club's signed-in members (the form fills the name and address from the account, and the sign-in brings the member back to the page), or only people the club invites by email (a new fold **«Invitații»** with «Trimite invitațiile», «Retrimite» and «Retrage», a personal single-use link in each email and the club's line in Romanian and English). The event's page says «Căutăm voluntari dintre membrii clubului» for the members, and nothing at all for the invited; a person's data screen lists and erases the invitations sent to an address. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given an event whose volunteers are «Doar membrii clubului», when a request without a members' session posts the volunteers' form, then it is refused on the server (`FORBIDDEN`) and nothing is written whatever the page drew, and when a member posts it with an address other than the account's, then it is refused too; and given an event whose volunteers are «Doar cu invitație de la club», when a request posts the form without a live invitation's secret, then it is refused, the volunteers' page answers 404 without a link, and the invitations are sent, sent again and withdrawn by the Organizer and the Administrators alone and listed to them alone (2026-10-19, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given an invitation to volunteer, when its email is rendered, then its link's secret is minted then and only its SHA-256 is stored (the outbox's payload names the invitation and the event by id alone), a newer email's link replaces the older one's and «Retrimite» kills the older one at the press, a GET of the volunteers' page with the link changes nothing, the sign-up spends the link in its own transaction by one conditional update so that a second press, a withdrawn link, a link of an event that is over or called off and a link of another event are refused with a sentence and write nothing, a race moved to a later day keeps its links open, the address on the form is the invitation's whatever is posted, and a message whose invitation was used or withdrawn, whose event is over, or whose address changed, is withdrawn at the send (2026-10-19, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given an event that takes volunteers, when an Organizer or an Administrator opens its «Voluntari» card, then they choose who may offer — anyone, the club's members or only the invited — as a radio group saved by the card's own form (which deletes no sign-up and no invitation, tells the public cache and writes this date alone), the choice travels with a duplicate, with every date of a repeat and with the event's file, written there only when it is not «Oricine» and never over an existing event, and the club's line of an invitation is written in Romanian and in English or in neither, each half of the email saying its own (2026-10-19, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given the club's invitations to volunteer sent to an address, when an Administrator opens «Toate datele unei persoane» or downloads its file, then each is listed with its event, its moments and the club's line in both languages and counted in the export's audit row, an address with only invitations is not reported as unknown, «Șterge invitațiile de voluntariat» erases them on request after a question and audits only the count, deleting a volunteer deletes the invitation the sign-up came through even after a colleague corrected the address, and the retention sweep deletes the invitations of an event thirty days after it started and none of an event still ahead (2026-10-19, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: volunteers: the club chooses who may offer — anyone, the club's signed-in members, or only people it invites by email
